org.legendPeer: Nobody contacts a colleague directly: the system mediates.
org.hidden: Names are visible to leads and above.

setup.venuesHint: Names, services by weekday, positions used
setup.areasHint: The seven areas and who belongs to each
setup.positionsHint: Local names and who reports to whom
setup.floorPlansHint: Sections, tables and seats per venue
setup.menuHint: Food, drinks and wine with photos
setup.thresholdsHint: Warning states, weekly hours, side work

venues.title: Venues and services
venues.name: Name
venues.slugHelp: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes. Used in links.
venues.reservationsHelp: Resy, OpenTable, SevenRooms or Tock page, opened from the floor screens.
venues.activeHelp: An inactive venue disappears from every screen but keeps its history.
venues.servicesHelp: Each service runs on the weekdays you pick.
venues.endsHelp: Past midnight is fine: 02:00 ends the next day.
venues.positionsUsedHelp: Only these positions appear in the schedule, the team and the org chart of the venue.
venues.slugTaken: Another venue already uses this code.

areasPage.title: Areas and layers
areasPage.intro: Every position belongs to one area and one layer. Areas decide content: which menu, which side work, which rules and which leader. Layers decide what a person can do.
areasPage.fixed: Areas and layers are part of the product and cannot be edited here. Rename a position for a venue in Positions and chain.

layerHelp.support: Side work, own schedule and own warnings.
layerHelp.service: Serves guests; adds what their position needs, such as table notes or shortages.
layerHelp.lead: Runs an area: sections, pre-shift, 86s, proposes warnings for the team.
layerHelp.manager: Runs the venue: schedule, shift, close, issues warnings.
layerHelp.corporate: Runs the company: every venue, standards, approvals.

positionsPage.title: Positions and chain
positionsPage.intro: Rename a position for one venue (captain or head waiter) and change who it reports to. The chain decides who proposes warnings and where requests escalate.
positionsPage.localNameHelp: Leave empty to use the standard name.

rulesPage.title: Rules
rulesPage.intro: Company rules apply to everyone; position rules apply to everyone who works that position. Each published version must be confirmed before the next shift.
rulesPage.published: New version published. Everyone concerned will confirm it.
rulesPage.publishHelp: Publishing asks every person concerned to confirm the new version before their next shift.
rulesPage.locked: Managers edit this set from their venue.

thresholds.title: Thresholds and limits
thresholds.warningsIntro: States are computed over a rolling window. Set when a person reaches each state.
thresholds.attentionMinor: Attention from this many minor warnings
thresholds.followUpMinor: Follow-up from this many minor warnings
thresholds.followUpMajor: Follow-up from this many major warnings
thresholds.reviewMajor: Review from this many major warnings
thresholds.orderError: Each state needs at least as many warnings as the one before it.
thresholds.weeklyHoursHelp: Managers see people above this as Over limit when they build the schedule.
thresholds.sideWorkMinutes: Side work limit, minutes per shift
thresholds.sideWorkPct: Side work limit, share of the shift
thresholds.sideWorkHelp: New York limits non-tipped side work for tipped staff to 2 hours or 20 % of the shift. Validate with counsel.

tips.title: Tip policy
tips.intro: Optional. The written tip-pool policy and the points per position, which tipped staff confirm like a rule. The First never stores or calculates amounts.
tips.counsel: New York requires a written policy and excludes managers with real authority from the pool. Have it reviewed by employment counsel before publishing.
tips.none: No policy published for this venue.
tips.participantsHelp: Only tipped positions can take part. Points in quarter steps.
tips.published: Policy published. Tipped staff will confirm it.
tips.managerInPool: Managers cannot take part in the tip pool.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Every action listed in the security rules, newest first.
